title: Chewi Definition 1.5.5: full f-divergence including singular mass
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling (2026-08-09), Definition 1.5.5, printed p. 39 / PDF p. 51: for convex f : R_+ -> R with f(1)=0, define D_f(mu||nu)=integral f(dmu/dnu) dnu when mu << nu; in general, for common dominating densities p_mu,p_nu and f'(infinity)=lim_{t->infinity} f(t)/t, add the singular correction f'(infinity) mu{p_nu=0} to the integral over {p_nu>0}.
target_statement: Provide one source-faithful measure-level f-divergence object covering both the absolutely-continuous integral and Chewi's singular-mass extension, without using a totalized real Bochner integral to represent a potentially infinite divergence. Reuse Mathlib Radon-Nikodym / withDensity infrastructure and avoid introducing a second incompatible density hierarchy.
consumers: Chewi Theorem 8.3.1 source-facing simultaneous f-divergence flow

searched: Samplinglib main: no general fDivergence/Csiszar divergence declaration found; current SimultaneousFDivergence modules only formalize common-reference scalar/integral calculus
Samplinglib main: RNLogRatio.lean provides the canonical real RN representative but not a general f-divergence value
Pinned Mathlib v4.33.0 code search: no Csiszar/fDivergence object found
Pinned Mathlib: Bochner integral on real-valued functions is totalized and therefore cannot by itself represent Definition 1.5.5's possibly infinite value
Pinned Mathlib: EReal exists, but no directly reusable EReal-valued measure integral / Csiszar divergence API was found by the current reuse audit
shared_floor_audit.notes: The source definition is strictly broader than the absolutely-continuous real integral used in the proof of Theorem 8.3.1. In the singular case it requires both the asymptotic slope f'(infinity) and a singular-mass correction, and its value may be infinite. Defining it prematurely as an ordinary real Bochner integral would silently map non-integrable cases through Mathlib totalization and lose the source semantics. The finite absolutely-continuous child #231 is now proved locally and feeds the active Theorem 8.3.1 route; that progress does not discharge the remaining singular/extended-value child.

blocked.reason: Definition 1.5.5 has a potentially infinite singular correction, while the current Samplinglib route only has real-valued totalized Bochner integration. A source-faithful codomain/integration design for the singular branch must be isolated instead of silently coercing it to a finite real value.
